Do the task (code, queries, source reads — whatever is needed) # 3. Snapshot AFTER npx tsx scripts/eval-snapshot.ts /tmp/snap-after-t${TASK}.json # 4. Write artifact + commit (LLM fills --notes and --queries-made) npx tsx s

# Switch to all-facts mode kb config set fact_retrieval_method all_facts # Switch back to the default kb config set fact_retrieval_method query_expansion # Or unset to use the default kb config unset fact_retrieval_method
* 📥 **Index** — Parse code (AST) and markdown docs to extract facts automatically
* 🔁 **Refresh** — Re-scan after changes to keep the knowledge base current
* 🔍 **Query** — Ask questions in natural language; get grounded, source-linked answers
**Agentic while loop** — replaces the old fixed `MAX_CHAT_TOOL_ROUNDS`.
**Better error messages**: Tool-specific error handling, not mode-dependent branches

**Canonical external benchmark:** the [raylib C library](https://github.com/raysan5/raylib) — use suite `raylib` (its `repo_url` is defined in `eval/suites/raylib.yaml`; override with `--repo` only when needed).
**Concept frontier** — facts sharing any concept token in the active concept set.
**Concept rows** — facts sharing active concepts (broader union than frontier).
**Contract:** the KB answers questions and drives authoring from **atomic facts** in the `facts` store.
**Cursor:** `.mdc` targets get `alwaysApply: true` injected into YAML frontmatter.
**Decompose pre-step** — for synthesis/elaboration queries (≥40 chars matching
**Deterministic segmentation** — walk the page in order; each sentence or paragraph (configurable grain) becomes a **candidate fact** text.
**Do not edit files in `_original_docs/` or `_autogenerated_docs/` by hand** — they are overwritten on every publish.
**Do not start the next task until the artifact for the current task is committed.**
**Domain-specific cycle loops** — deterministic multi-pass orchestration for commands with a fixed lifecycle such as `kb init` and `kb publish`.
**Easier to test**: Narrow contract = clear test cases
**Edge neighbors** — `getFactNeighbors(activePond.frontierFactIds, seenIds, perIterationLimit)`: one BFS hop from the **active pond's** frontier only.
**Evidence header** — one `evidence>` summary line (count, mix, themes, leads, walk/stop/conf).
**Export:** The full graph can be dumped as Graphviz DOT (for visualisation tools like Gephi or Mermaid) or JSON (for your own analysis).
**Fewer parameters to reason about**: Each tool does one thing well
**Follows production precedent**: `claude-code` uses FileReadTool, FileEditTool, FileWriteTool (not polymorphic FileOperationTool)
**For complex or multi-faceted questions**, call `query_kb` multiple times with different angles before answering.
**Future:** HDBSCAN-based auto-discovery (currently commented out in `src/cli/init-cli.ts`) will run before the manual step to suggest categories derived from the actual fact corpus.
**Graph expansion** — before each retrieval, `expandQueryWithGraph` may widen the query
**Grey context lines** — last ≤6 lines of the in-flight content, capped at 100 chars/line, shown below the spinner in grey/dim (`LoadingSpinner` renders these from `entry.content`).

**How the fallback worked:** `crawlSourceCode()` walked the repo for the extensions above (up to 200 files, 400 chars/file), then one LLM call per file produced `{ module_summary, facts[] }` rows as `source_kind='import_code'`.
**Hybrid retrieval** — SQLite full-text search + vector-style ranking returns relevant docs even when phrasing differs between the query and the stored fact.
**Ignored entirely**: images, binaries, lock files, compiled artifacts.

**Implemented:** `buildDocgenFactContext` + injection **before** draft and revision LLM calls; **zero** supporting facts → **error** (no finalize); `## References` still appended from the same fact set.
**Integration points** (what other tools does it coordinate with?)
**Intent is self-documenting**: `merge_documents` → agent knows it's merging
**Invariant:** after `/init` or `/scan` completes, `awaitRefreshThenStart(refreshBase, startChatSession)` must be used — not bare `refreshBase(); startChatSession()`.
**Invariant:** init progress strings match `init-status.ts` parsing (`[init]`, `[scan]` prefixes) so the bar can parse `6/6 ast-facts …` style lines without polluting `HistoryPane`.
**Invariant:** long-running work that prints incremental status must use the injected output, not raw `console.log`, when invoked from the TUI.
**Invariants:** One imperative, testable rule per bullet.
